title: What demonstrated need would justify a Master Workbench?
question: What demonstrated need would justify a Master Workbench?
answer: WB-9: Validate through real, contrasting existing Workbenches and products, not artificial pilots. Candidates include LLM Workbench, Master Workbench, GPT_OS, Cashflow Calculator, CIC, OpenBrain and Foundry; pick the next from live owner priorities. Each proof must show owner-useful delivery, named verification and truthful fresh-session continuation. Revisit Master Workbench only when several such proofs show a concrete need for its registry, observation audit or visualization role.
